rationale: Allow one bounded correction for a proven second Candidate deployment sandbox blocker. A root-owned transient systemd probe with ProtectSystem=strict and ReadWritePaths=/run failed to create a new mode-2770 directory when RestrictSUIDSGID=true, while the otherwise identical probe succeeded with mode 2770 when RestrictSUIDSGID=false. The approved Candidate bootstrap must create new commit-specific 2770 and 2750 directories that do not yet exist. Change only the exact Candidate deployment broker's RestrictSUIDSGID setting required for those governed setgid directories, retain ProtectSystem=strict and every ReadWritePaths/InaccessiblePaths/credential/Stable boundary, and add focused regression coverage. No generic root command, broad filesystem write, supervisor permission, Stable mutation, credential access, or danger-full-access is authorized.
